manifest.notes: Technical description of src/SwapReceiptHook.sol and src/RCPT.sol, with ABI exports at docs/abi/SwapReceiptHook.json and docs/abi/RCPT.json. The hook's sole constructor argument is the approved Sepolia PoolManager; RCPT has no constructor arguments. The intended pool has native ETH as currency0, RCPT as currency1 and SwapReceiptHook as its hook. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96, equal to TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(138180), matching script/LaunchConfig.sol and the one-sided RCPT launch rehearsal in test/LaunchRehearsal.t.sol. Only afterSwap is enabled; all other permissions, including return-delta permissions, are false. The constructor validates hook address bits, requiring a CREATE2 address whose low 14 bits equal 0x0040. Initialization and liquidity changes have no enabled callbacks. afterSwap requires the configured PoolManager and returns zero delta without charging a hook fee. Qualifying zeroForOne buys with at least 0.001 ETH actually settled mint one soulbound ERC-721 receipt, using settled deltas for exact-input, exact-output and partial fills. The collection is Swap Receipts (SWAPRCPT). Receipt ids start at 1; records contain ETH paid, tokens received, currency1, block number and timestamp, with a Receipt event carrying poolId. Crediting requires exactly 32 bytes of hookData encoding a nonzero address with clean upper bits; invalid data credits nobody and there is no router-sender fallback. hookData is unauthenticated: anyone can credit any address through a qualifying buy, so a receipt does not prove its recipient traded. Sells, smaller buys and non-native-ETH pools mint nothing. Other native-ETH pools record their own currency1. Minting uses _mint without a recipient callback; transfers and approvals revert and there is no burn. Views provide totalMinted, receiptOf, receiptsOf and on-chain base64 JSON/SVG tokenURI. There are no administrative or upgrade entry points. This manifest does not set deployment policy or certify independent review, attestation, admission or deployment; policy and signed artifact linkage are handled separately by services.
